versions.changelog:
employee-handover v1.0.0

- Initial release of the employee-handover skill.
- Generates structured handover sheets for departing employees, supporting data gathering from various chat and task platforms (DingTalk, Feishu, WeChat, Teams, Slack, etc.) via API or manual input.
- Produces a 3-section handover table (Business Sources / Data Storage / Ongoing Items) and detailed appendices (Unfinished Tasks, Data Location Matching, Contacts, Checklist).
- Supports both automated data collection and manual user input, with platform-agnostic and fallback options to ensure compatibility and data completeness.
- Delivers final output as an Excel file; provides Markdown/CSV versions with assembly instructions if automated tools are unavailable.
- Emphasizes privacy, source accuracy, and validation steps before delivery.
